criteria.requirement: Add textdistance.bounded.bounded_levenshtein(left,right,cutoff,qval=1,test_func=None) returning the exact unit-cost distance when <= cutoff and None otherwise. Implement valid length-difference rejection and a banded dynamic program with sparse rows, not a full matrix followed by cosmetic truncation. Preserve prepared words/qgrams, arbitrary equality predicates, Unicode and exact cutoff equality. Validate strict nonnegative integer cutoff (not bool); no normalized cutoff ambiguity or optional-backend bypass. Demonstrate actual reduced comparisons for long narrow-band inputs and never expose None as a real score.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
